zh: 量子玩法
en: Quantum games

zh: 两人都答 0：不管收到什么。它是这套玩法的基准。
en: Both answer 0, whatever they receive. This is the game's benchmark.

zh: 只有 x = y = 1 的那一种输入会输：赢 3/4
en: only the input x = y = 1 loses: wins 3/4

zh: 各自随便答：每回合抛一枚自己的硬币。
en: Each answers at random: every round each player flips a coin of their own.

zh: s.rnd() 是自己的随机数，对方看不到
en: s.rnd() is this player's own random number; the other player cannot see it

zh: 经典的答法表：Alice 收到 0 答 a0、收到 1 答 a1；Bob 收到 0 答 b0、收到 1 答 b1。
en: Classical answer table: Alice answers a0 on receiving 0 and a1 on receiving 1; Bob answers b0 on receiving 0 and b1 on receiving 1.

zh: s.role 是 "A"（Alice）或 "B"（Bob），s.x 是自己收到的那个比特
en: s.role is "A" (Alice) or "B" (Bob); s.x is the bit this player received

zh: 共用随机数挑答法：每回合按两人共有的随机数，以 w 的概率一起用"都答 0"，否则一起用"照收到的比特答"。
en: Shared randomness picks the table: every round, using the random number both players share, they both use "both answer 0" with probability w, and otherwise both use "answer the bit you received".

zh: s.shared：这一回合两人共有的随机数（事先约好的一本随机数表）
en: s.shared: the random number both players share this round (a table of random numbers agreed on in advance)

zh: 另一张答法表：收到什么就答什么（只在 x = y = 0 时赢）
en: the other answer table: answer whatever you received (wins only when x = y = 0)

zh: 测量纠缠光子（一个角度 φ）：Alice 收到 0 沿 0° 测、收到 1 沿 2φ 测；Bob 收到 0 沿 φ 测、收到 1 沿 −φ 测。两人都报测到的结果。
en: Measure the entangled photon (one angle φ): Alice measures at 0° on receiving 0 and at 2φ on receiving 1; Bob measures at φ on receiving 0 and at −φ on receiving 1. Both report what they measured.

zh: 把偏振片转到 deg 度，测自己手里的那个光子：通过 = 0，被挡住 = 1
en: turn the polarizer to deg degrees and measure your own photon: passes = 0, blocked = 1

zh: 测量纠缠光子（四个角度）：Alice 收到 0、1 分别沿 α0、α1 测，Bob 收到 0、1 分别沿 β0、β1 测。两人都报测到的结果。
en: Measure the entangled photon (four angles): Alice measures at α0 or α1 on receiving 0 or 1, Bob at β0 or β1 on receiving 0 or 1. Both report what they measured.

zh: Alice 和 Bob 每回合用 s.shared 把两个人的偏振片一起转一个随机的角度：胜率会变吗
en: Every round Alice and Bob use s.shared to turn both polarizers by the same random angle: does the win rate change

zh: 只在收到 1 的时候测量，收到 0 的时候直接答 0
en: Measure only on receiving 1; on receiving 0 just answer 0

zh: 先用经典答法表，再只把 Bob 换成测量
en: Start from a classical answer table, then switch only Bob to measuring

zh: 输掉的回合
en: Lost rounds

zh: ⑮ Bell 游戏
en: ⑮ Bell game

zh: Bell 游戏
en: Bell game

zh: 裁判每回合各给 Alice 和 Bob 一个随机比特，两人不能通气，各答一个比特：两人都收到 1 时要答得不同，其余时候要答得相同。什么都不带，最多赢 75%；各拿一个纠缠光子，能赢到 85%。
en: Every round the referee gives Alice and Bob one random bit each. They cannot communicate, and each answers with one bit: when both received 1 their answers must differ, otherwise they must agree. With nothing in hand they win at most 75%; holding one photon each of an entangled pair, they can win 85%.

zh: 一局多少回合
en: Rounds per episode

zh: 一局就是一次实验：回合越多，一次实验越能分辨 75% 和 85%
en: One episode is one experiment: the more rounds, the better a single experiment separates 75% from 85%

zh: 光子从哪里来
en: Where the photons come from

zh: 纠缠光子对
en: Entangled photon pairs

zh: 局部隐变量源
en: Local hidden-variable source

zh: 每回合一对处在 |Φ⁺⟩ = (|HH⟩ + |VV⟩)/√2 的光子，Alice 和 Bob 各拿一个。可以加白噪声：可见度 v < 1 时，有 1 − v 的概率这一对光子是完全随机的。
en: Every round a pair of photons in |Φ⁺⟩ = (|HH⟩ + |VV⟩)/√2, one for Alice and one for Bob. White noise can be added: with visibility v < 1, the pair is completely random with probability 1 − v.

zh: Bell 自己写下的那种经典模型：每对光子出厂时带着同一个隐藏的偏振方向 λ（在 0° 到 180° 之间均匀），测量结果由偏振片的角度和 λ 决定，哪一边的结果都不受另一边的角度影响。
en: The kind of classical model Bell himself wrote down: each pair leaves the source carrying the same hidden polarization direction λ (uniform between 0° and 180°), and each outcome is determined by that side's polarizer angle and λ. Neither side's outcome depends on the other side's angle.

zh: 纠缠的可见度 v
en: Visibility of the entanglement v

zh: 1 = 理想的纠缠；低于 1/√2 ≈ 0.707 时，任何测量角度都赢不过 75%
en: 1 = perfect entanglement; below 1/√2 ≈ 0.707 no choice of angles beats 75%

zh: 胜率
en: Win rate

zh: 累计赢的回合
en: Rounds won so far

zh: 这一回合要答得不同吗（x 与 y 都是 1）
en: Must the answers differ this round (x and y both 1)

zh: 两人答得不同（a ⊕ b）
en: The two answers differ (a ⊕ b)

zh: CHSH 值 S（经典 ≤ 2，量子 ≤ 2√2）
en: CHSH value S (classical ≤ 2, quantum ≤ 2√2)

zh: Bob 答 1 的比例：Alice 收到 1 时减收到 0 时
en: Share of Bob's answers that are 1: when Alice received 1 minus when she received 0

zh: 单看这一局就能断定超过了 75% 的比例（高出 3 个标准误）
en: Share of episodes that alone establish a win rate above 75% (by 3 standard errors)

zh: 不用纠缠的任何做法的上限（Bell–CHSH 不等式）
en: Upper limit of any strategy without entanglement (Bell–CHSH inequality)

zh: 局部隐变量源下的最好成绩：和不用纠缠一样
en: Best possible with a local hidden-variable source: the same as without entanglement

zh: 量子力学允许的最好成绩：1/2 + v·√2/4（v = 1 时是 Tsirelson 界 cos²22.5°）
en: Best that quantum mechanics allows: 1/2 + v·√2/4 (for v = 1 the Tsirelson bound cos²22.5°)

zh: 可见度不到 1/√2：最好的仍是不用纠缠的 75%（测量最多 §0§%）
en: Visibility below 1/√2: the best is still 75% without entanglement (measuring gives at most §0§%)

zh: 理论：隐变量源上的胜率
en: Theory: win rate with the hidden-variable source

zh: 理论胜率 1/2 + v·(3cos2φ − cos6φ)/8
en: Theoretical win rate 1/2 + v·(3cos2φ − cos6φ)/8

zh: 理论：两张答法表按 w 混合，1/4 + w/2
en: Theory: the two answer tables mixed with weight w, 1/4 + w/2

zh: 都答 0
en: Both answer 0

zh: 各自随便答
en: Each answers at random

zh: 纠缠光子，但都沿 0° 测
en: Entangled photons, both measured at 0°
Entangled photons, standard angles (0°/45° vs 22.5°/−22.5°)

zh: 理想纠缠
en: Perfect entanglement

zh: 可见度 0.9
en: Visibility 0.9

zh: 可见度 0.7
en: Visibility 0.7

zh: 一局 50 回合
en: 50 rounds per episode

zh: 一局 1000 回合
en: 1000 rounds per episode

zh: 同一段代码给两个人用：每回合裁判先问 Alice、再问 Bob。s.role 是 "A" 或 "B"；s.x 是这个人自己收到的比特（0 或 1），对方的那一个他看不到。
en: One piece of code serves both players: every round the referee asks Alice first, then Bob. s.role is "A" or "B"; s.x is the bit this player received (0 or 1). Neither sees the other's bit.

zh: 动作：返回这个人的答案，0 或 1（≥ 0.5 算 1）。两人的答案 a、b 满足 a ⊕ b = x ∧ y 就赢：只有两人都收到 1 时要答得不同。
en: Action: return this player's answer, 0 or 1 (≥ 0.5 counts as 1). The answers a, b win if a ⊕ b = x ∧ y: only when both received 1 must they differ.

zh: s.measure(deg)  把偏振片转到 deg 度（角度制），测自己手里的那个光子：通过返回 0，被挡住返回 1。每回合每人只能测一次，再调用返回同一个结果。
en: s.measure(deg)  turn the polarizer to deg degrees and measure your own photon: returns 0 if it passes, 1 if it is blocked. Each player may measure once per round; calling again returns the same result.

zh: s.shared       这一回合两人共有的一个 (0,1) 随机数（事先约好的随机数表）；s.rnd() 是自己的随机数
en: s.shared       a random number in (0,1) that both players share this round (a table of random numbers agreed on in advance); s.rnd() is the player's own random number

zh: s.last         上一回合赢了没有（1 = 赢，0 = 输，第一回合是 NaN）；s.ret(k) 是 k+1 回合之前那一回合是否"要答得不同"
en: s.last         whether the previous round was won (1 = won, 0 = lost, NaN in the first round); s.ret(k) says whether the round k+1 rounds ago was one where the answers "had to differ"

zh: st             Alice 和 Bob 各有自己的一份 st（init 各调用一次），互不相通。代码顶层的变量是两人共用的：拿它传话就是作弊，胜率可以超过量子力学的上限 85.36%，那正是传了话的证据。
en: st             Alice and Bob each have their own st (init is called once for each), and the two do not connect. Variables at the top level of the code are shared by both: using them to pass messages is cheating. The win rate can then exceed the quantum limit of 85.36%, which is exactly the evidence that a message was passed.

zh: s.g.src  s.g.v  s.g.T   光子从哪来（"q" 纠缠，"lhv" 局部隐变量）、可见度、一局多少回合
en: s.g.src  s.g.v  s.g.T   where the photons come from ("q" entangled, "lhv" local hidden variables), the visibility, rounds per episode

zh: 每次都直接测：不转，测出来的就是随便猜的一个盒子。它是这套玩法的基准。
en: Measure every time: no rotation, so what you measure is a box picked at random. This is the game's benchmark.

zh: 0 = 测量并核对；1 = 再转一步
en: 0 = measure and check; 1 = rotate one more step

zh: 固定转 k 步再测：落空了就从头再来，还是转 k 步。
en: Rotate k steps, then measure: after a miss, start over and again rotate k steps.

zh: s.k：上次测量之后已经转了几步
en: s.k: steps rotated since the last measurement

zh: 转到成功率最高再测（Grover）：转 ⌊π/(4θ)⌋ 步，sin θ = √(M/N)。不知道有几个奖品时，当作只有一个。
en: Rotate to the peak success probability, then measure (Grover): rotate ⌊π/(4θ)⌋ steps, sin θ = √(M/N). When the number of prizes is unknown, assume there is one.

zh: s.g.M 是 NaN：不知道有几个奖品，就当作 1 个
en: s.g.M is NaN: the number of prizes is unknown, so assume 1

zh: 按期望查询次数最少来转：在"转 k 步、落空重来"里挑 (k + 1)/P(测中) 最小的 k。比转到成功率最高要早停。
en: Rotate for the fewest expected queries: among "rotate k steps, start over after a miss", pick the k that minimizes (k + 1)/P(hit). It stops earlier than rotating to the peak success probability.

zh: 转 k 步再测，测中的概率（算上退相干）
en: probability of a hit when measuring after k steps (with decoherence)

zh: 每一轮花 k + 1 次查询，平均要 1/pk 轮
en: each try costs k + 1 queries, and 1/pk tries are needed on average

zh: 不知道有几个奖品（Boyer–Brassard–Høyer–Tapp）：每一轮从 0 到 m − 1 里随机挑转几步，落空就把 m 放大 λ 倍，直到 √N 为止。
en: Unknown number of prizes (Boyer–Brassard–Høyer–Tapp): each try rotates a number of steps drawn at random from 0 to m − 1; after a miss, m grows by a factor λ, up to √N.

zh: j = −1：这一轮转几步还没定
en: j = −1: the number of steps for this try is not chosen yet

zh: 这一轮测完：下一轮的范围放大
en: this try is measured: widen the range for the next one

zh: 先按只有一个奖品转，落空一次就把转的步数减半
en: Rotate as if there were one prize, and halve the number of steps after each miss

zh: 不知道有几个奖品：先用几轮经典的随便猜估计 M，再按估出来的 M 转
en: Unknown number of prizes: estimate M from a few classical random guesses first, then rotate for the estimated M

zh: 退相干的世界里：每轮只转到 √N 的一半就测
en: With decoherence: measure each try after only half of the √N rotation

zh: 测量并核对
en: Measure and check

zh: 退相干了
en: Decohered

zh: 已经找到
en: Already found

zh: ⑯ 量子搜索
en: ⑯ Quantum search

zh: 量子搜索
en: Quantum search

zh: 次查询
en: queries

zh: N 个盒子里藏着奖品，问一次黑盒算一次查询。每次查询，要么让量子计算机再转一步，要么测量、并用这次查询核对测出来的那个盒子。找到奖品为止，比谁用的查询少。
en: Prizes are hidden in N boxes, and each call to the black box is one query. With each query you either rotate the quantum computer one more step, or measure it and use the query to check the box you measured. Play until a prize is found; the fewer queries, the better.

zh: 量子比特数 n（盒子数 N = 2ⁿ）
en: Qubits n (boxes N = 2ⁿ)

zh: n = 10 时 N = 1024；n = 20 时超过一百万
en: n = 10 gives N = 1024; n = 20 gives more than a million

zh: 查询预算
en: Query budget

zh: 用完还没找到，这一局按预算记
en: If the budget runs out before a prize is found, the episode counts as the full budget

zh: 奖品有几个
en: How many prizes

zh: 正好 M 个，你知道 M
en: Exactly M, and you know M

zh: 1 到 M 个之间，你不知道
en: Between 1 and M, unknown to you

zh: 每一局都正好藏着 M 个奖品，位置随机，规则读得到 M。
en: Every episode hides exactly M prizes at random positions, and the rule can read M.

zh: 每一局的奖品数在 1 到 M 之间均匀地抽，规则读不到它（s.g.M 是 NaN，s.g.Mmax 是 M）。
en: The number of prizes is drawn uniformly between 1 and M in each episode, and the rule cannot read it (s.g.M is NaN, s.g.Mmax is M).

zh: 奖品数 M（或上限）
en: Prizes M (or the upper limit)

zh: 每转一步退相干的概率
en: Probability of decoherence per step

zh: 退相干之后整个寄存器变成完全混合态：再转也没用，测量就是随便猜
en: After decoherence the whole register is in the completely mixed state: further rotation is useless and a measurement is a random guess

zh: 找到奖品用掉的查询次数
en: Queries used to find a prize

zh: 已经用掉的查询
en: Queries used so far

zh: 此刻测量能测中的概率（只有裁判知道）
en: Probability that measuring now finds a prize (known only to the referee)

zh: 再转一步
en: Rotate one more step

zh: 预算内没找到的比例
en: Share not found within the budget

zh: 平均测量了几次
en: Average number of measurements

zh: 这一局的奖品数
en: Prizes in this episode

zh: 每次都直接测（公式）
en: Measure every time (formula)

zh: 经典的最好做法：不放回地一个一个查（公式）
en: Best classical method: check the boxes one by one without repeats (formula)

zh: 转 §0§ 步再测（转到成功率最高，公式）
en: Rotate §0§ steps, then measure (peak success probability, formula)

zh: 转 §0§ 步再测（这一族里期望查询最少，公式）
en: Rotate §0§ steps, then measure (fewest expected queries in this family, formula)

zh: 理论：转 k 步、落空重来
en: Theory: rotate k steps, start over after a miss

zh: 每次都直接测
en: Measure every time

zh: 转到成功率最高再测（Grover）
en: Rotate to peak success, then measure (Grover)

zh: 按期望查询最少来转
en: Rotate for fewest expected queries

zh: 不知道有几个：随机步数、逐轮放大（λ = 1.2）
en: Unknown count: random steps, growing range (λ = 1.2)

zh: 1024 个盒子，1 个奖品
en: 1024 boxes, 1 prize

zh: 4 个奖品，知道
en: 4 prizes, known

zh: 1 到 16 个，不知道
en: 1 to 16, unknown

zh: 每步 1% 退相干
en: 1% decoherence per step

zh: 每步 5% 退相干
en: 5% decoherence per step

zh: 只有 16 个盒子
en: Only 16 boxes

zh: 2²⁰ 个盒子
en: 2²⁰ boxes

zh: 动作：返回 1 = 再转一步（一次 Grover 迭代，花一次查询）；返回 0 = 测量，并花一次查询核对测出来的那个盒子。测中了这一局结束；落空了，寄存器重新准备成均匀叠加态，从头再来。
en: Action: return 1 = rotate one more step (one Grover iteration, costs one query); return 0 = measure, and spend one query checking the box you measured. A hit ends the episode; after a miss the register is prepared in the uniform superposition again and you start over.

zh: s.k          上次测量之后已经转了几步（测量之后归零）
en: s.k          steps rotated since the last measurement (reset to zero by a measurement)

zh: s.fails      已经落空了几次；s.last 是上一次测量的结果（1 = 测中，0 = 落空，没测过是 NaN）
en: s.fails      number of misses so far; s.last is the result of the last measurement (1 = hit, 0 = miss, NaN before any)

zh: s.g.N  s.g.n  盒子数 N = 2ⁿ、量子比特数 n；s.g.T 是查询预算
en: s.g.N  s.g.n  number of boxes N = 2ⁿ, number of qubits n; s.g.T is the query budget

zh: s.g.M        奖品数（不知道时是 NaN）；s.g.Mmax 是它的上限；s.g.eps 是每转一步退相干的概率
en: s.g.M        number of prizes (NaN when unknown); s.g.Mmax is its upper limit; s.g.eps is the probability of decoherence per step

zh: s.rnd()      (0,1) 上的均匀随机数。量子态本身规则看不到：它在裁判手里，只能通过转和测去碰。
en: s.rnd()      a uniform random number in (0,1). The rule cannot see the quantum state itself: it is in the referee's hands and can be touched only by rotating and measuring.

zh: 直接看一眼：光子转到竖直偏振、整个送进炸弹那一路，再测。经典的检查方法。它是这套玩法的基准。
en: Just look: turn the photon to vertical polarization, send all of it down the bomb's path, then measure. The classical test. This is the game's benchmark.

zh: 测过了：竖直（1）判哑弹，水平（0）判真炸弹
en: measured already: vertical (1) means dud, horizontal (0) means live

zh: 新的光子：转 90°，走一圈
en: a fresh photon: turn it 90° and make one pass

zh: 走完了：测量
en: pass done: measure

zh: 不测，直接猜：真炸弹的比例过半就判真，否则判哑。
en: Guess without testing: declare live if more than half of the bombs are live, otherwise declare a dud.

zh: −1 = 判真炸弹，−2 = 判哑弹
en: −1 = declare live, −2 = declare a dud

zh: 量子芝诺：每次只转 90°/N，走一圈，重复 N 次再测。水平偏振判真，竖直判哑；光子半路丢了就换一个从头来。
en: Quantum Zeno: turn by only 90°/N each time and make one pass; repeat N times, then measure. Horizontal polarization means live, vertical means dud; if the photon is lost on the way, take a new one and start over.

zh: s.n：这个光子已经走了几圈（换光子时归零）
en: s.n: passes this photon has made (reset when the photon is replaced)

zh: 按损耗和预算选步数：开局之前倒推出每一种 N 的期望得分，取最好的 N，再按量子芝诺的做法测。
en: Steps chosen for the loss and the budget: before play starts, compute the expected score of every N by backward induction, take the best N, then measure the quantum-Zeno way.

zh: 只用到细则里的常数（D.g：每颗几步、真炸弹的比例、丢光子的概率、炸一颗扣几分），不看数据。N 从 1 试到 min(400, T − 2)
en: uses only constants from the rulebook (D.g: steps per bomb, share of live bombs, photon loss probability, penalty per explosion), not the data. N is tried from 1 to min(400, T − 2)

zh: 换一个新光子、还剩 r 步时的期望得分 f(r)：a 是一圈下来光子还在、也没炸的概率，boom 是每圈炸掉的扣分
en: expected score f(r) with a fresh photon and r steps left: a is the probability that the photon survives one pass, neither lost nor exploding; boom is the penalty for exploding on a pass

zh: W(r) = Σ a^(j−1)·f(r − j)：丢了光子从头来
en: W(r) = Σ a^(j−1)·f(r − j): a lost photon means starting over

zh: 走完 N 圈、测量、判定：都判对，得 1 分
en: N passes made, measured, declared: always correct, 1 point

zh: 倒推的结果：N = §0§ 最好，期望每颗得 §1§ 分。
en: Result of backward induction: N = §0§ is best, with an expected score of §1§ per bomb.

zh: 先转小角度试几圈，光子丢得多就把步数减少
en: Try a few passes with small angles first, and reduce the number of steps if many photons are lost

zh: 走完 N 圈测出水平之后，再换一个光子复核一次
en: After N passes measure horizontal, check once more with a new photon

zh: 炸弹检测
en: Bomb testing

zh: 一批炸弹真假混杂，真炸弹只要被一个光子碰到就会炸。不碰它，能不能知道它是真的？每一步把光子的偏振转一个角度、让它走一圈，竖直偏振的那一部分会去炸弹那一路。转得越小越安全，可光路会丢光子，步数也有限。
en: A batch of bombs, some live and some duds; a live bomb explodes as soon as a single photon touches it. Can you tell it is live without touching it? Each step turns the photon's polarization by some angle and sends it around the loop, and the vertically polarized part goes down the bomb's path. The smaller the turns, the safer, but the loop loses photons and the number of steps is limited.

zh: 每颗炸弹最多用几步
en: Steps per bomb at most

zh: 转一次走一圈、测量一次、做出判定，各占一步
en: Turning and making a pass, measuring, and declaring take one step each

en: Only 30 steps per bomb

zh: 动作：返回一个正数 a = 把光子的偏振再转 a 度，然后让它走一圈：竖直偏振的那一部分去炸弹那一路，水平的那一部分走另一路，最后汇合。
en: Action: return a positive number a = turn the photon's polarization a further a degrees, then send it around the loop: the vertically polarized part goes down the bomb's path, the horizontal part takes the other path, and the two merge at the end.

zh: 返回 0 = 测量光子的偏振（水平 → s.last = 0，竖直 → s.last = 1）。这个光子用掉了，下一步换一个新的，从水平偏振开始。
en: Return 0 = measure the photon's polarization (horizontal → s.last = 0, vertical → s.last = 1). The photon is used up; the next step starts with a new one, horizontally polarized.

zh: 返回 −1 = 判定"是真炸弹"，返回 −2 = 判定"是哑弹"，这一局结束：判对 +1，判错 −1。炸了扣 s.g.c 分，步数用完还没判是 0 分。其他的数什么也不做，白白用掉一步。
en: Return −1 = declare "live", return −2 = declare "dud"; the episode ends: correct +1, wrong −1. An explosion costs s.g.c points, and running out of steps without a verdict scores 0. Any other number does nothing and wastes a step.

zh: 真炸弹：光子竖直偏振的那一部分走进炸弹那一路就会炸，概率是 sin²(此刻的偏振角)；没炸的话，光子一定走的是另一路，偏振塌回水平。哑弹：什么也不发生。
en: Live bomb: the vertically polarized part of the photon explodes it on entering the bomb's path, with probability sin²(current polarization angle); if there is no explosion, the photon certainly took the other path and its polarization collapses back to horizontal. Dud: nothing happens.

zh: s.n          这个光子已经走了几圈；s.turned 是它累计转过的角度（度，按 180° 取余）；换光子时都归零
en: s.n          passes this photon has made; s.turned is its total rotation (degrees, mod 180°); both reset when the photon is replaced

zh: s.lost       上一步光子是不是在光路里丢了（1 = 丢了，已经换了一个新的）；s.photons 是到现在用了几个光子
en: s.lost       whether the photon was lost in the loop on the previous step (1 = lost, already replaced by a new one); s.photons is the number of photons used so far

zh: s.last       上一次测量的结果（0 水平，1 竖直，没测过是 NaN）
en: s.last       result of the last measurement (0 horizontal, 1 vertical, NaN before any)

zh: s.g.q  s.g.eps  s.g.c  s.g.T   真炸弹的比例、每圈丢光子的概率、炸一颗扣几分、每颗最多几步
en: s.g.q  s.g.eps  s.g.c  s.g.T   share of live bombs, photon loss probability per pass, penalty per explosion, steps per bomb at most

zh: 真假混杂的炸弹，会丢光子的光路
en: Live bombs mixed with duds, a loop that loses photons

zh: 每颗炸弹是真是假各自独立地抽，真的概率是 q。光子在光路里每走一圈，有 ε 的概率被吸收掉；被吸收的光子碰不到炸弹。
en: Each bomb is live or a dud independently, live with probability q. On every pass around the loop the photon is absorbed with probability ε; an absorbed photon never reaches the bomb.
